title: Jesus has the convulsed boy brought and rebukes the unclean spirit
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the boy's father; the unclean spirit
note: Healing order like AUD-46-4-35; parallels Matthew 17:17–18 and Mark 9:19–25 are also unrecorded.

title: Jesus tells the disciples to let his betrayal prediction sink in
speaker: Jesus
note: 'Place these words in your ears'; parallels Matthew 17:22–23 and Mark 9:30–32 are unrecorded.

title: Jesus rebukes James and John for wanting fire on a Samaritan village
speaker: Jesus
note: Rebuke is narrated, not quoted; it forbids retaliation against a village that refused Jesus.

title: Woe to the towns that saw Jesus' mighty works without repenting
speaker: Jesus
recipient: Chorazin, Bethsaida and Capernaum (spoken to the seventy-two)
note: Woes are in scope as Wisdom; parallel Matthew 11:20–24 is also unrecorded.

title: Blessed are the eyes that see what the disciples see
speaker: Jesus
note: Beatitude; parallel Matthew 13:16–17 is also unrecorded. 10:21–22 is prayer to the Father, out of scope.

title: Show mercy as the Samaritan did
speaker: Jesus
note: Record holds only the application (10:36–37); link the parable body, including the care paid for at the inn (10:35).

title: Whoever is not with Jesus is against him
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the crowd and those attributing his exorcisms to Beelzebul
note: Beelzebul teaching (strong man, empty house) has no record; parallels Matthew 12:25–30,43–45 and Mark 3:23–27 unrecorded.

title: Repent at Jesus' preaching as Nineveh repented at Jonah's
speaker: Jesus
note: Sign of Jonah teaching has no record; parallel Matthew 12:38–42 is also unrecorded.

title: Woe to Pharisees who love the foremost seats and greetings
speaker: Jesus
note: Same charge as Matthew 23:6–7 within K027.

title: Woe to those who are like unmarked tombs
speaker: Jesus
topic: Clean and Unclean, and the Tradition of the Elders
note: Lukan form of the tombs woe in Matthew 23:27–28.

title: Woe to lawyers who load burdens they will not touch
speaker: Jesus
note: Same charge as Matthew 23:4 within K027.

title: Woe to those who build prophets' tombs yet share their killers' guilt
speaker: Jesus
note: Parallel Matthew 23:29–36 is also unrecorded.

title: Woe to lawyers who take away the key of knowledge
speaker: Jesus
note: Parallel Matthew 23:13 is also unrecorded. 11:53–54 is narrative.

title: Guard against greed and reliance on possessions
speaker: Jesus
recipient: a man seeking an inheritance ruling, and the crowd
note: Add the inheritance request and the rich fool parable, which illustrate 12:15; parable imperatives need no own record.

title: Be dressed for service and ready for the master's return
speaker: Jesus
note: 12:39–40 matches Matthew 24:43–44, already Additional Scripture on K083.

title: Expect allegiance to Jesus to divide even households
speaker: Jesus
note: Declarative teaching with no record; parallel Matthew 10:34–36 is also unrecorded.

title: Interpret the present time as you read the weather
speaker: Jesus
note: Parallel Matthew 16:2–3 is also unrecorded; 12:57–59 is already K006.

title: The mustard seed and leaven show the kingdom's hidden growth
speaker: Jesus
note: Kingdom parables, like recorded AUD-44-13-44; parallels Matthew 13:31–33 and Mark 4:30–32 are unrecorded.

title: Choose the lowest place at a feast
speaker: Jesus
recipient: guests at a leading Pharisee's meal
note: 14:8–9 gives the same directive negatively: do not take the foremost place.

title: Do not refuse God's great supper with excuses
speaker: Jesus
recipient: a fellow guest at the Pharisee's table
note: Parable of the great supper has no record; parallel Matthew 22:1–14 is also unrecorded.

title: Salt that loses its taste is thrown out
speaker: Jesus
note: Same salt saying as Mark 9:50; in Luke it closes the cost of discipleship.

title: Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear
speaker: Jesus
note: Formula already linked from Mark 4:9 and Matthew 13:9,43.

title: Jesus teaches about using wealth and being faithful in small matters
speaker: Jesus
note: Add the shrewd steward parable (16:1–8), whose lesson 16:9 states; its inner imperatives need no own record.

title: Heed Moses and the Prophets before it is too late
speaker: Jesus (Abraham speaking in the parable)
note: Rich man and Lazarus parable has no record; 16:29 'let them hear them' is its directive.

title: Faith like a mustard seed could uproot a tree into the sea
speaker: Jesus
note: Same saying as Mark 11:22–23; Matthew 17:20 is unrecorded. 17:5 is a request to the Lord.

title: Serve without claiming special credit
speaker: Jesus
note: 17:7–9 is the illustration whose application (17:10) the record already holds.

title: Jesus teaches persistence in prayer
speaker: Jesus
note: Add the widow and unjust judge parable, including 18:6 'Hear what the unrighteous judge says.'

title: Jesus has the blind man brought and tells him to receive sight
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the blind man near Jericho, and the crowd
note: Healing order like AUD-46-5-24; parallels Mark 10:49–52 and Matthew 20:32–34 are unrecorded.

title: Jesus tells Zacchaeus to hurry down because he must stay with him
speaker: Jesus
note: Zacchaeus episode has no record; his pledge of fourfold restitution (19:8) belongs in it.

title: Pharisees demand that Jesus rebuke his disciples' praise
speaker: some Pharisees in the crowd
note: 19:37–38 is praise, out of scope; the Pharisees' demand (19:39) and Jesus' refusal could be recorded.

title: The parable of the tenants warns those who reject the owner's son
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the people in the temple, aimed at the chief priests and scribes
note: Parable of the wicked tenants has no record; parallels Matthew 21:33–46 and Mark 12:1–12 are unrecorded.

title: The Lord's invitation to sit at his right hand
speaker: the Lord, quoted by Jesus from David
topic: Minor Teachings: The Scriptures Read in Christ
note: Quotation of Greek Psalm 109:1.

title: Jesus stops the sword and heals the slave's ear
speaker: Jesus
note: Lukan account of Matthew 26:51–54; John 18:10–11 is already linked.

title: The crowd demands Barabbas' release and Jesus' crucifixion
speaker: the chief priests, rulers and people
note: Same demand for crucifixion as John 19:6–7; parallels Matthew 27:20–23 and Mark 15:11–14 are unrecorded.

title: Pilate sentences Jesus to crucifixion at the crowd's demand
speaker: Pilate
recipient: the chief priests, rulers and people
note: Proposed flogging and release (23:16,22), then the sentence (23:24–25); John 19:16, Matthew 27:26 and Mark 15:15 are unrecorded.

title: Believe all that the prophets spoke about the Christ's suffering
speaker: the risen Jesus
recipient: two disciples on the road to Emmaus
topic: Minor Teachings: The Scriptures Read in Christ
note: Emmaus rebuke and Scripture interpretation have no record; compare AUD-46-24-5 (remember his words).

title: The Emmaus disciples urge the stranger to stay with them
speaker: Cleopas and his companion
note: Ordinary hospitality request, comparable to recorded Old Testament hospitality requests.

title: The risen Jesus tells the disciples to see and touch him
speaker: the risen Jesus
recipient: the Eleven and those with them
note: Includes his request for food (24:41); same evening as John 20:19–20. Compare AUD-47-20-24 (Thomas).

title: Jesus commissions his witnesses and tells them to wait in the city
speaker: the risen Jesus
note: 24:44–45 opens the same charge: everything written in the Law, Prophets and Psalms must be fulfilled.

title: Jesus invites John's two disciples to come and see
speaker: Jesus
recipient: Andrew and another disciple of John
note: Call of Andrew and another disciple; the recorded call of Philip (AUD-47-1-43) follows.

title: Jesus gives Simon the name Cephas, that is, Peter
speaker: Jesus
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Divine renamings are itemized (C0034 Abraham, C0058 Israel); Mark 3:16 and Matthew 16:18 records do not itemize it.

title: Philip invites Nathanael to come and see Jesus
speaker: Philip
note: A disciple's invitation, echoing Jesus' 'come and see' (1:39).

title: Mary tells the servants to do whatever Jesus tells them
speaker: Mary, the mother of Jesus
recipient: the servants at the wedding in Cana
note: Distinct speaker from Jesus' own instructions in AUD-47-2-7 (2:7–8).

title: Jesus teaches Nicodemus about birth from above
speaker: Jesus
note: 3:8–15 continues the same teaching: the Spirit like wind, and belief in the lifted-up Son.

title: Believe in the Son God sent so as not to perish
speaker: Jesus (or the evangelist)
note: Same call as John 6:29; 3:17 states the Son's saving purpose.

title: Whoever does the truth comes to the light
speaker: Jesus (or the evangelist)
note: Declarative teaching on conduct; compare AUD-47-12-34 (walk in the light).

title: He must increase, but I must decrease
speaker: John the Baptist
note: John's maxim of self-effacement before Christ, closing his answer to his disciples.

title: Jesus asks the Samaritan woman for a drink
speaker: Jesus
recipient: a Samaritan woman at Jacob's well
note: An ordinary request of the kind the catalogue records; it crosses the Jewish–Samaritan divide.

title: Ask Jesus for living water that ends thirst
speaker: Jesus
note: Same living-water invitation as John 7:37–39; 4:15 is her request.

title: Jesus tells the Samaritan woman to call her husband
speaker: Jesus
note: Direct order that exposes her situation and leads to the worship teaching (K026).

title: Jesus tells the Samaritan woman about worship in spirit and truth
speaker: Jesus
note: 4:20 states the disputed rule about where one must worship, which 4:21–24 answers.

title: The Samaritan woman invites her townspeople to come and see Jesus
speaker: the Samaritan woman
note: Her testimony leads many Samaritans to believe (4:39–42).

title: Jesus sends his disciples to reap where others have labored
speaker: Jesus
note: 4:31–34 (the disciples' 'Rabbi, eat' and Jesus' saying about his food) opens the same exchange.

title: Jesus tells the royal official to go, for his son lives
speaker: Jesus
recipient: a royal official whose son lay ill in Capernaum
note: Healing word like AUD-46-7-11; 4:47 and 4:49 are petitions to Jesus, out of scope.

title: Honor the Son as the Father is honored
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the Jews seeking to kill him
note: 5:25–30 continues the discourse, including 'Do not marvel at this' and judgment by deeds.

title: Jesus explains how his works and the Scriptures bear witness to him
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the Jews seeking to kill him
topic: Minor Teachings: The Scriptures Read in Christ
note: 5:31–35 (John's testimony, 'so that you may be saved') opens the same witness teaching.

title: Jesus tells the disciples on the sea not to fear
speaker: Jesus
note: Parallels Matthew 14:27 and Mark 6:50 are also unrecorded.

title: Believe in the one God has sent
speaker: Jesus
note: 6:35–37 restates the call: whoever comes and believes will never hunger or thirst. 6:34 is a request.

title: Jesus tells the crowd to stop grumbling among themselves
speaker: Jesus
note: Includes the Prophets quotation 'they shall all be taught by God' (6:45).

title: Jesus teaches about eating his flesh and drinking his blood
speaker: Jesus
topic: Do This in Remembrance of Me
note: 6:48–51 is the same bread-of-life teaching that 6:53–56 completes.

title: Jesus' brothers urge him to go to Judea and show himself
speaker: Jesus' brothers
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Unbelieving advice; Jesus declines, saying his time has not yet come, and sends them up to the feast.

title: The chief priests and Pharisees rebuke officers for not seizing Jesus
speaker: the chief priests and Pharisees
note: The arrest order itself (7:32) is also unrecorded; compare AUD-47-11-55.

title: Establish a charge by two or three witnesses
speaker: Jesus, answering the Pharisees
note: Widen the John 8:17–18 link: the Pharisees' objection to self-testimony (8:13–14) begins the same argument.

title: Believe that Jesus is 'I am' or die in your sins
speaker: Jesus
note: Same call to believe in the one God sent; 8:28 adds that the lifted-up Son will be known.

title: Whoever keeps Jesus' word will never see death
speaker: Jesus
note: K043 already links John 8:30–36 (remain in my word); 8:48–55 is dispute.

title: Go and wash in the pool of Siloam
speaker: the healed man, recounting Jesus' order
note: Retelling of the order recorded at 9:7 (also 9:15); retold orders are linked elsewhere, e.g. Acts 11:4–10.

title: The authorities threaten synagogue exclusion for confessing Jesus as Christ
speaker: the Pharisees and Jewish authorities
recipient: the healed man and his parents
note: The 'Give glory to God' adjuration (9:24) and the expulsion (9:34) carry out the threat.

title: Admit blindness; those who claim to see remain in sin
speaker: Jesus
recipient: the healed man and the Pharisees with him
note: Includes the call to believe in the Son of Man (9:35–38); a judgment saying on spiritual blindness.

title: Enter through Jesus, the door, and follow the shepherd's voice
speaker: Jesus
note: Shepherd-and-door figure has no record; AUD-47-10-14 begins at 10:14. Covers candidate 10:9–10 (P02795).

title: Jesus calls his opponents to consider his works
speaker: Jesus
note: 10:25 'the works I do... bear witness' opens the same appeal; 10:33 states the blasphemy charge.

title: Jesus tells the disciples they will return to Judea for Lazarus
speaker: Jesus
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Direction to go back despite the threat of stoning; 11:9–10 is reported separately.

title: Walk while there is light, and you will not stumble
speaker: Jesus
note: Same light-and-walking image as John 12:35–36 and 8:12, both on AUD-47-12-34.

title: Thomas urges the disciples to go and die with Jesus
speaker: Thomas called Didymus
note: A disciple's exhortation to follow Jesus into danger.

title: Believe in Jesus, the resurrection and the life
speaker: Jesus
note: 'Do you believe this?' renews the call to believe in the one sent; 11:27 is Martha's confession.

title: Caiaphas counsels that one man should die for the nation
speaker: Caiaphas the high priest
recipient: the council of chief priests and Pharisees
note: Council counsel recorded like Gamaliel's (AUD-48-5-34); it leads to the plot (11:53) and AUD-47-11-55.

title: Zion is called to rejoice at the coming of her humble king
speaker: the Lord through Zechariah, quoted by the evangelist
topic: Minor Teachings: The Scriptures Read in Christ
note: Quotation of Zechariah 9:9; the crowd's acclamation (12:13) is praise, out of scope.

title: Isaiah accepts the Lord's commission and receives its message
speaker: Isaiah, quoted by the evangelist
topic: Minor Teachings: The Scriptures Read in Christ
note: Quotation of Isaiah 6:10, already linked from Acts 28:25–27.

title: Wash one another's feet as Jesus did
speaker: Jesus
note: The washing itself and 'unless I wash you, you have no share with Me' (13:4–11) precede the command.

title: Jesus tells Judas to do quickly what he is about to do
speaker: Jesus
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 13:29: the disciples assumed an errand, buying for the feast or giving to the poor.

title: Believe that Jesus is in the Father and the Father in him
speaker: Jesus
note: Lead-in to 14:11, already linked on K081; 14:8 is Philip's request.

title: Jesus tells the disciples to rise and leave with him
speaker: Jesus
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Spoken as he goes to do 'just as the Father commanded Me'.

title: Remain in Jesus as branches in the vine
speaker: Jesus
note: 15:6 (the branch thrown out) sits between the record's 15:4–5 and its linked 15:7–10; 15:1–3 opens the figure.

title: Remember that the world hated Jesus before it hated you
speaker: Jesus
note: Compare AUD-47-16-1 (remember the warning) and Matthew 10:24–25; the slave-and-master saying recalls 13:16.

title: Ask the Father in Jesus' name
speaker: Jesus
note: 16:26–27 continues: 'on that day you will ask in My name', for the Father loves you.

title: Jesus tells the high priest to question those who heard him
speaker: Jesus
note: Appeal to proper testimony, comparable to AUD-47-7-50; 18:23 asks for testimony about any wrong spoken.

title: Pilate offers the Passover custom of releasing one prisoner
speaker: Pilate
note: Custom with legal force, like AUD-48-25-13; parallels Matthew 27:15 and Mark 15:6 are unrecorded.

title: Jesus' accusers invoke their law in demanding his death
speaker: the chief priests and officers
note: 19:12–15 continues the same demand ('Take Him away! Crucify Him!') with the appeal to Caesar.

title: The chief priests ask Pilate to reword the inscription on the cross
speaker: the chief priests
note: Pilate refuses: 'What I have written, I have written.'

title: The soldiers agree to cast lots for Jesus' seamless tunic
speaker: the soldiers at the cross
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: A 'let us' resolution, as the catalogue records Genesis 11:3; fulfils Greek Psalm 21:19.

title: Mary asks the supposed gardener where he has laid Jesus
speaker: Mary Magdalene
recipient: the risen Jesus, taken for the gardener
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Ordinary request; the commission that follows is AUD-47-20-16.

title: The risen Jesus directs the catch and invites the disciples to breakfast
speaker: the risen Jesus
recipient: seven disciples fishing on the Sea of Tiberias
note: Cast the net (21:6), bring fish (21:10), come and eat (21:12); compare Luke 5:4, also unrecorded.

title: Follow Jesus without speculating about the other disciple
speaker: the risen Jesus
note: 'Follow Me' (21:19), after the prediction of Peter's death, is the charge repeated in 21:22.

title: Angels ask the disciples why they stand gazing into heaven
speaker: two men in white (angels)
note: Rhetorical rebuke with a promise of return; in scope only if read as a direction to stop gazing.

title: Peter connects the outpouring of the Spirit with Joel's prophecy
speaker: Peter, standing with the Eleven
recipient: the people of Judea and Jerusalem
topic: Minor Teachings: The Scriptures Read in Christ
note: 2:14–15 ('let this be known to you, and listen closely to my words') opens the same explanation.

title: The believers share their resources to meet needs
speaker: the Jerusalem believers (described)
recipient: one another, as any had need
note: Same practice of selling property and distributing to need as Acts 4:32–35.

title: Salvation is found in Jesus alone
speaker: Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: 4:10–11 ('let it be known... in the name of Jesus Christ'; the rejected stone) leads into 4:12.

title: Do not lie to the Holy Spirit about what you give
speaker: Peter
note: Peter's rebukes (5:3–4,9): the property was theirs to keep; the sin was lying to God.

title: Abram: recognize the foretold exile and oppression of your descendants
speaker: God, quoted by Stephen
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Stephen's retelling of Genesis 15:13–14; Acts 7 retellings are already linked on C0021, C0062 and C0063.

title: Pharaoh puts Joseph in charge of Egypt
speaker: Pharaoh, recalled by Stephen
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Stephen's retelling of Genesis 41:40–44.

title: Joseph sends his brothers to bring Jacob to Egypt
speaker: Joseph, recalled by Stephen
note: Stephen's retelling of Genesis 45:9.

title: Moses urges two quarrelling Israelites to stop wronging each other
speaker: Moses, recalled by Stephen
topic: Human life, injury and care for neighbours
note: Its source, Exodus 2:13–14, is also unrecorded; the wrongdoer rejects Moses as ruler and judge.

title: The people ask Aaron to make gods to lead them
speaker: the Israelites, recalled by Stephen
note: Stephen quotes Exodus 32:1.

title: Paul recalls John's instruction to believe in the one coming after him
speaker: John the Baptist
recipient: priests and Levites sent from Jerusalem
note: John's own testimony to the one coming after him, which Acts 19:4 summarizes; 1:19–23 is linked on ot-isaiah-v40-3.

title: Stephen's opponents set up false witnesses against him
speaker: Stephen's opponents
note: Suborned false testimony, contrary to the false-witness law (C0157); recorded only as a hostile direction.

title: Peter tells Simon to repent after trying to buy the gift
speaker: Peter
note: Simon's request to buy the power (8:18–19) is the occasion of Peter's command.

title: The Ethiopian official stops the chariot and asks to be baptized
speaker: the Ethiopian eunuch
note: Reported order and request; the commission to Philip (AUD-48-8-26) ends at 8:35.

title: Summon Peter from Joppa
speaker: an angel, as recounted by Cornelius
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Cornelius retells the angel's order of 10:5–6; 10:33 adds 'to hear everything the Lord has commanded you'.

title: Peter tells the believers to inform James of his release
speaker: Peter
recipient: the believers gathered at Mary's house
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 'Report these things to James and the brothers', given after the angel's rescue (AUD-48-12-6).

title: Herod orders the guards led away for execution
speaker: Herod (Agrippa)
note: Reported hostile order, like AUD-44-2-16 (Herod and the boys of Bethlehem).

title: Paul rebukes Elymas for opposing the faith and pronounces blindness
speaker: Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit
note: 'Will you not stop making crooked the Lord's straight ways?' is the implied directive; the blindness is judgment.

title: Synagogue rulers invite Paul and Barnabas to speak a word of encouragement
speaker: the synagogue rulers at Pisidian Antioch
note: Shows synagogue order: reading of the law and prophets, then exhortation; Paul answers 'listen' (13:16).

title: Paul recalls John's instruction to believe in the one coming after him
speaker: Paul, recalling John the Baptist
note: Same recollection of John's baptism of repentance and the one coming after him as Acts 19:4.

title: God invites the people to listen and promises an enduring covenant
speaker: God, quoted by Paul
topic: Minor Teachings: The Scriptures Read in Christ
note: Quotes the promise of Isaiah 55:3; 13:33 (Greek Psalm 2:7) is declaration, out of scope.

title: Believe the proclaimed forgiveness and beware of scoffing at God's work
speaker: Paul
note: Paul's sermon (13:16–41) has no record before 13:43; quotes Habakkuk 1:5, itself unrecorded. 13:42 is the hearers' request.

title: Paul tells the man lame from birth to stand upright
speaker: Paul
recipient: a man lame from birth at Lystra
note: Healing order like AUD-48-3-4 and AUD-48-9-32; it prompts the Lystra episode (AUD-48-14-11).

title: Do not test God by putting the yoke on Gentile disciples
speaker: Peter
recipient: the apostles and elders in council
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: Peter's council speech: all are saved through grace; it precedes James' decree (A111).

title: The Jerusalem council sets out four abstentions for Gentile believers
speaker: James, with the apostles and elders
topic: Minor Teachings: The Scriptures Read in Christ
note: James' speech opens at 15:13 with a call to listen and grounds the decree in Amos 9:11–12 (15:16–18).

title: Paul proposes to Barnabas revisiting the churches they planted
speaker: Paul
note: Leads to the dispute over John Mark and the separation of Paul and Barnabas.

title: Lydia urges Paul's company to stay at her house
speaker: Lydia of Thyatira
note: Hospitality request after her household's baptism.

title: The Philippian magistrates order Paul and Silas beaten and jailed
speaker: the magistrates of Philippi
note: Reported orders (16:22–23) after the charge of unlawful customs (16:20–21); the jailer obeys (16:24).

summary: Luke 9:38–Acts 17:3: 65 new, 25 extend, 30 parallel; main gaps are unrecorded Lukan parables and woes, John's dialogue commands, Passion-trial orders and early Acts speeches.
